# vendor

The files the skill examples load, committed so the examples render from an installed plugin, offline and in sandboxes with no CDN access. `scripts/vendor.sh` in the source repo refreshes them.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `js/d3.v7.min.js` | d3 7.9.0, d3js.org | ISC |
| `esm/d3.mjs` | d3 7.9.0, esm.sh bundle | ISC |
| `esm/topojson-client.mjs` | topojson-client 3.1.0, esm.sh bundle | ISC |
| `data/us-atlas/counties-10m.json` | us-atlas 3 (US Census Bureau cartographic boundaries) | ISC |
| `data/world-atlas/countries-110m.json` | world-atlas 2 (Natural Earth) | ISC |
